name: Stochastic Extragradient (SEG)
tagline: Korpelevich-style two-step extragradient: take a stochastic look-ahead gradient at z, then update z with the gradient at the look-ahead point.
diff_from_baseline: Korpelevich 1976 / Juditsky-Nemirovski-Tauvel 2011 (stochastic version). Canonical extragradient method for monotone variational inequalities and convex-concave saddle problems.

name: Restarted-SEG
tagline: SEG with an anchoring (proximal) pull λ(anchor − iterate) toward the initial point at every half-step.
formula: $$w_t = z_t - \tau g(z_t) + \tau\lambda(z_0 - z_t) + \xi_t,\quad z_{t+1} = z_t - \tau g(w_t) + \tau\lambda(z_0 - w_t) + \xi'_t$$
diff_from_baseline: Halpern-style anchored extragradient (Yoon & Ryu 2021; Diakonikolas 2020). SEG augmented with a fixed anchor pull yields accelerated last-iterate rates for monotone inclusions.

name: Stochastic Extra-Anchor GD
tagline: SEG with a 1/(t+3) anchor coefficient: time-decaying pull toward the initial point at every step.
formula: $$\eta_t = \frac{1}{t+3},\quad w_t = z_t - \tau g(z_t) + \eta_t (z_0 - z_t) + \xi_t,\quad z_{t+1} = z_t - \tau g(w_t) + \eta_t (z_0 - z_t) + \xi'_t$$
diff_from_baseline: Halpern (1967) iteration applied to SEG. Time-varying anchoring coefficient 1/(t+3) is the standard Halpern weight; gives O(1/t) gradient-norm rate for monotone problems.

name: RAIN (Re-Anchoring via Iterate Nesting)
tagline: SEG variant whose anchor is a running geometric-weighted average of past iterates rather than the fixed initial point.
diff_from_baseline: Reference RAIN method (problem package namesake). Replaces the fixed Halpern anchor with a geometric-weighted running average, improving robustness to noise on ill-conditioned saddle problems.
